Madonna - CONFESSIONS II – 16-track Deluxe CD + Continuous Mix [CDRIP, FLAC 16bit 44.1kHz]

CONFESSIONS II (also known as Confessions on a Dance Floor: Part 2) is the forthcoming fifteenth studio album by Madonna. Prior to the release of the album's lead single, "I Feel So Free" was released as a promotional single and made available on streaming services on April 18, 2026, following it's exclusive debut on iHeartRadio the previous day. The album's lead single "Bring Your Love," a collaboration with Sabrina Carpenter, was released on April 30, 2026, three days after it's announcement on social media. "Love Sensation" was also released as a promotional single.
